title: Cartwise Shopper Batches — Setting Waiting-Time Pay Against the Offer
content:
In a shown-pay claim on a Cartwise Shopper Batches batch, the waiting-pay offset share decides how much of the waiting-time pay posted on the batch is set against the offer:

- **one half** when the posted waiting-time pay is **2.00 or more**;
- **three quarters** when it is **at least 1.00 and below 2.00**;
- **all of it** when it is **below 1.00**.

The part not set against the offer is taken out of the pay before tips standing that the claim compares with the offer.

## Reading the rule

| Waiting-time pay posted on the batch | Share set against the offer | Part taken out of the pay standing |
|---|---|---|
| 2.00 or more | 0.50 | One half of it |
| From 1.00 up to but not including 2.00 | 0.75 | One quarter of it |
| Below 1.00 | All | Nothing |

The waiting-time pay is the total of the waiting-time pay components posted on the batch.

## Hypothetical figures

- Posted waiting-time pay 2.70, pay standing 16.20: half of 2.70 (1.35) is not set against the offer, so the pay standing counted is 14.85.
- Posted waiting-time pay exactly 2.00: one half, 1.00, is taken out.
- Posted waiting-time pay 1.20: one quarter, 0.30, is taken out.
- Posted waiting-time pay 0.90: nothing is taken out.
